name: E3D Titan
description: The E3D Titan is a well-established single drive extruder featuring a hobbed bolt and a 3:1 gear reduction. Compatible with both direct drive and bowden configurations, it was one of the first compact gear-reduction extruders widely adopted in the 3D printing community. The Titan is no longer in production but remains widely used and referenced.
features: Hobbed bolt drive with single-sided grip
Compatible with direct drive and bowden setups
Proven design with wide community support
